| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mode** `mode` | Remove noise | Remove noise, Keep one direction | Remove noise sets the small coefficients of every tile to 0. Keep one direction keeps only the tiles near one orientation. |
| **Scales** `scales` | 3 | 2 to 5 | How many bands of directional tiles, each an octave of frequency. A coarse low-pass tile covers the rest. |
| **Directions** `directions` | 16 | 8, 16, 32 | The number of directions at the finest scale, over 180 degrees. It halves every second scale toward the coarse end, down to 4. |
| **Threshold factor** `factor` | 3 | 0 to 8 | For removing noise, the threshold is this factor times the noise in each tile. 0 keeps every coefficient. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 | The standard deviation of the noise, in pixel values. 0 estimates it from the finest diagonal wavelet details. |
| **Line angle** `direction` | 0 | 0 to 180 deg | For keeping one direction, the angle of the lines to keep, counterclockwise on screen. 0 keeps horizontal lines. |
| **Angle range** `width` | 15 | 1 to 90 deg | For keeping one direction, the tiles whose orientation is within this many degrees of the line angle are kept. |
| **Keep coarse part** `keepCoarse` | on | On or off | For keeping one direction, also keep the coarse low-pass tile, which has no direction. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
